changed: Four subagents in .claude/agents: explorer (read-only research, haiku), verifier (gate and verification levels, JSON report, preloads eng-verify), reviewer (fresh-context review JSON, opus, preloads eng-review), sandbox-operator (reads the manual-only live-sandbox skill, acts on owner instruction). The first three disallow Edit, Write and NotebookEdit; 14 conformance tests.

rulings.ruling: The reviewer returns the review JSON and the caller writes and validates it, so the reviewer keeps no write tools
rulings.cost_if_wrong: one extra step for the caller

rulings.ruling: sandbox-operator reads live-sandbox instead of preloading it, because a disable-model-invocation skill cannot be preloaded
